issues.description: resolve(from, '..', s) assumes `from` is a file path without stating or enforcing the precondition
issues.detail: The argument-order change in DecodedMap works for filesystem file paths but silently breaks when `from` is a directory, empty, or a URL — `..` then climbs one level too high. The intent is path.resolve(path.dirname(from), s); naming it that way (or documenting and asserting the precondition) avoids a fragile trick. No test pins the contract.

issues.description: createConvertSourceMapReadMap returns '{}' for missing map files, masking failures as empty success
issues.detail: Returning the literal string '{}' conflates 'file missing' with 'empty JSON map' and depends on convert-source-map tolerating that exact shape. Downstream consumers receive a syntactically valid but semantically empty map and cannot distinguish absence from malformed reference. Return undefined or throw and let the caller decide.

issues.description: Synchronous readFileSync on every external stack frame during async error serialization, with no cache
issues.detail: getSourceMap performs blocking existsSync + readFileSync per file inside Promise.all error formatting, and convert-source-map issues a second read for the referenced map. No cache, no async alternative. On large external stacks this re-reads and re-parses the same files repeatedly and blocks the event loop. A Map<file, SourceMap|null> is the obvious fix.

issues.description: getSourceMap hook lacks documented failure semantics and may throw from readFileSync
issues.detail: The new callback can return undefined, a SourceMap, or implicitly throw on I/O errors. Callers and alternate implementations need a stated contract — e.g. return undefined on any failure, never throw — otherwise subtypes will violate the supertype contract and error reporting itself will surface I/O exceptions.

issues.description: Source-map helpers live in test-run.ts but belong in packages/utils/src/source-map.ts
issues.detail: extractSourcemapFromFile and createConvertSourceMapReadMap are stateless source-map transforms unrelated to TestRun lifecycle. Placing them in test-run.ts couples an unrelated responsibility to the run reporter module. Move them next to DecodedMap so the module boundary matches responsibility.

issues.description: Negative-path tests missing; correctness rests on a snapshot diff
issues.detail: The only evidence is two updated snapshots showing .js to .ts remapping. No tests pin resolve() semantics for absolute or URL inputs, nor for missing/malformed maps, nor that stacks fall back to transpiled locations when getSourceMap returns undefined. Add tests for these failure modes.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the fix is directionally correct — external-module stack frames now resolve to original sources — but the implementation lacks the discipline its complexity demands. The resolve(from, '..', s) change assumes `from` is a file path without saying so; the new getSourceMap hook does unbounded synchronous I/O on every external frame with no cache; and the '{}' fallback masks missing maps as empty success. The helpers are also misplaced in test-run.ts rather than alongside the rest of the source-map utilities, and correctness rests on snapshots rather than negative-path tests. State the contracts, cache the reads, propagate absence honestly, and move the helpers.
